## Setup
```{r}
library("GimmeMyOmics")
library("GimmmeMySC")
library("GimmeMyPlot")
library("magrittr")
library("rlist")
library("Seurat")
library("cowplot")
library("kableExtra")
library("openxlsx")
library("clusterProfiler")

source(
  file.path(file.path(
  dirname(getwd()),
  "inst",
  "extdata"
), "conf.R"))

fc_threshold  <- log2(1.5)
p_threshold <- .05

if (species == "human") {
  org_lib <- "org.Hs.eg.db"
} else {
    org_lib <- "org.Mm.eg.db"
}
library(org_lib, character.only = TRUE)
filter <- dplyr::filter
select <- dplyr::select
rename <- dplyr::rename

method <- "ora"

if (method == "ora") {
  label_x <- "generatio"
} else {
  label_x <- "NES"
}

pseudo <- FALSE
```

## Load data

```{r}
if (!pseudo) {

} else {

load(file.path(path_data, paste0(seurat_dataset, ".rda")))
```

```{r}
data("term2gene_microarray")
term2gene <- term2gene_microarray
```

## Analysis
```{r}
if (method == "ora") {
  l_deg_proc <- list.map(
    l_deg,
    f(x) ~ {
        filter(x, Expression != "ns") %>%
        mutate(Expression = if_else(log2FoldChange > 0, "up", "down")) %>%
        split(.$Expression)
    }
  ) %>%
    set_names(names(l_deg)) %>%
    list_flatten(name_spec = "{outer}_{inner}") %>%
    list.map(
      f(x) ~ top_genes(
        x,
        fc_threshold = fc_threshold,
        p_threshold = p_threshold,
        return_rank = TRUE,
        n = 300
      )
  )
  
  l_enrich <- list.map(
    l_deg_proc,
    f(i) ~enricher(
            gene = pull(i, "gene_name"),
            # OrgDb = get(org_lib),
            # keyType = "ALIAS",
            # ont = "ALL",
            pvalueCutoff = 1,
            qvalueCutoff = 1,
            universe = Features(seurat),
            TERM2GENE = term2gene
        )
    ) %>% compact()
} else {
  var <- "gene_name"
  
  l_deg_proc <- list.map(
      l_deg,
      f(x) ~ {
          metric <- "log2FoldChange"
          de_genes_ranked <- top_genes(x, .Machine$double.xmin, 1, n = Inf, expression = TRUE) %>% #, rank = TRUE) %>%
              # mutate(ranked_padj = sign(log2FoldChange) * (log10(padj))) %>%
              pull(metric, name = var) %>%
              sort(decreasing = TRUE) %>%
              .[!is.na(names(.))] %>%
              .[is.finite(.)] %>%
              .[!duplicated(.)]
      }
  )
  l_enrich <- list.map(
    l_deg_proc,
    f(i) ~GSEA(
            i,
            # OrgDb = get(org_lib),
            # keyType = "ALIAS",
            # ont = "ALL",
            verbose = FALSE,
            TERM2GENE = term2gene
        ) %>%
      suppressWarnings() %>%
      invisible() %>%
      compact()
)
}
```

```{r}
cou <- list.map(
  l_enrich, 
  f(x) ~GimmeMyOmics:::extract_pathway_genes(x, method = "ora") %>%
    unlist() %>%
    unname()
  )  %>% 
  split(str_extract(names(l_enrich), "down|up")) %>%
  list.map(~set_names(., str_remove(names(.), "_down|_up")))

if (names(cou$up) %>% str_detect("vs") %>% any()) {
  
  l_deg_top_all <- list.map(
    cou,
    f(x, y, z) ~
    list.map(
      x, f(i, j, k) ~ filter(l_deg[[k]], gene %in% i) %>%
      arrange(rank_pfc)
    ) %>% set_names(paste0(names(.), "_", z))
    )
  
  l_deg_top_all <- c(l_deg_top_all[[1]], l_deg_top_all[[2]])

 } else if (isTRUE(pseudo)) {
  l_deg_top_all <- l_deg_proc
} else {
  l_deg_top_all <- map2(
   l_deg,
    cou$up, \(x, y) filter(x, gene %in% y) %>%
      arrange(rank_pfc)
    ) %>% 
       discard(~ nrow(.x) == 0)
}

top50 <- list.map(
    l_deg_top_all,  
    f(x, xx, xxx) ~head(x, 50) %>%
        mutate(cluster = xxx)) %>%
    list.rbind() %>%
  mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = names(l_deg_top_all)))

top5_filtered <- top50 %>%
  # list.map(
    filter(!duplicated(gene_name)) %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_head(n = 5) %>%
    ungroup()
  # )
markers <- top50  %>%
    split(.$cluster) %>%
    list.map(~pull(., gene_name) %>% unique()) %>%
  compact()
```

## Plot
```{r, message = FALSE, fig.height = 10, fig.width = 20}
l_plot_enrich <- function(l_enrich, regex = NULL) {
  list.map(
  l_enrich,
  f(i, j, k) ~{
        i <- filter_gsea(
          i,
          pathway_keywords()$cell_cycle,
          negate = TRUE
        )
      tmp <- print_enrich(
        i, 
        method = method,
        regex = regex
      )
      if (nrow(tmp) > 0)
        plot_enrich(
          i,
          cex = 0.65,
          label_x = label_x,
          method = method,
          regex = regex,
          n = 15,
          title = k
        )
      }
  ) %>% 
    compact()
}
p <- list.map(
  c("_up", "_down"),
  f(x) ~
  l_enrich %>% 
    keep_at(~ str_ends(.x, x)) %>%
    set_names(str_remove_all(names(.), x)) %>%
    l_plot_enrich() %>%
    plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 4, align = "hv") %>%
          plot_grid(
            ggdraw() + 
              draw_label(
                str_remove_all(x, "_") %>%
                  str_to_upper(),
                color = "#2F5496",
                size = 50,
                fontface = "bold.italic"
              ),
            .,
            ncol = 1,
            rel_heights = c(0.1, 1)
          )
  )
p
```

## Heatmap
```{r, message = FALSE, fig.height = 2, fig.width = 16}
l_heatmap_enrich <- function(l_enrich, l_deg_proc = l_deg_proc) {
  list.map(
  l_enrich,
  f(i, j, k) ~ {
    tmp <- print_enrich(i, method = method)
    if (nrow(tmp) > 0)
    heatmap_enrich_full(
      i,
      l_deg_proc[[j]],
      method = method,
      width_text = 100
    ) + 
      labs(
        title = str_replace(k, "(.*)_(.*)", "\\1 (\\2)") %>%
          str_to_title(),
        y = NULL, 
        x = NULL
      ) +
     theme_custom() +
     theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        color = "#2F5496",
        size = 50,
        face = "bold"
      )
    )
  }
) %>%
  compact()
}

p <- list.map(
    c("_up", "_down"),
    f(x) ~
        list.map(
            list(l_enrich, l_deg_proc),
            f(i) ~ i %>% 
                keep_at(~ str_ends(.x, x)) %>%
                set_names(str_remove(names(.), x))
        ) %>%
        purrr::reduce(l_heatmap_enrich)
)
p
```

## Nb DEG
```{r}
if (method == "ora") {
l_enrich_proc <- l_enrich %>%
  split(str_extract(names(l_enrich), "down|up")) %>%
    list.map(~set_names(., str_remove(names(.), "_down|_up")))
  
l_deg_proc <- split(l_deg_proc, str_extract(names(l_deg_proc), "down|up")) %>%
    list.map(~set_names(., str_remove(names(.), "_down|_up")))
  
  tmp <- list.map(
    l_enrich_proc, 
    ~list.map(., f(i) ~print_enrich(i, method = method) %>% nrow())
  )
   data.frame(
    Cluster = names(tmp$up),
    Up = unlist(tmp$up)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    data.frame(Cluster = names(tmp$down), Down = unlist(tmp$down)),
    by = "Cluster"
  ) %>% 
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
    kable_sc(
      file =  file.path(path_fig, "table_nb_pathways.png")
    )
  
} else {
  l_enrich_proc <- list(up = l_enrich)
  l_deg_proc <- list(up = l_deg_proc)
  list.map(l_enrich, f(i) ~print_enrich(i, method = method) %>% nrow()) %>%
    list.cbind() %>%
    set_rownames("# Pathway") %>%
    kable_sc(
      file =  file.path(path_fig, "table_nb_pathways.png")
    )
}
```
